newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Feb car sales revised lower - trade group.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Feb car sales revised lower - trade group.

text.p: Malaysia's passenger car sales totalled 16,181 units in February, a revision from the 16,654 units announced on Monday, the Malaysian Motor Traders' Association (MMTA) said on Wednesday.
In an amended statement, the trade group also revised lower the total number of commercial vehicle sales for February to 4,380 from the previously-reported 5,280.
The figures for passenger and commercial vehicles include four-wheel-drive vehicles.
In February 1996, 15,051 passenger vehicles were sold, while commercial vehicle sales totalled 4,163.
Fewer vehicles were sold in February this year due to a one-week holiday period to celebrate Chinese and Moslem festivals.
